case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for planning certainty on a binding volume, and all three of our options give your committee exactly that: a binding annual volume over a contract term twice as long as the one you proposed.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest commitment on volume and term, which is the footing a pricing committee needs to say yes. On the cost side you named copper and labour, so here is where we stand:

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our price history with you:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Because a step of this size goes beyond your own authority, we would ask you to take Option A to your pricing committee. For the committee: Option A secures a binding volume for the whole contract term, a longer term than your current offer and full planning certainty on both sides. It can be approved as it stands. If you need anything further for the committee's papers, we will gladly provide it.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your volume forecast and historical order data, which allows us to revise our position. We agree to the 24-month contract term to provide the requested planning certainty for both parties. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our Angebot contains a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. While we cannot accept the 90-day payment term in Option A, we propose EUR 429.43 based on your Option C with 45 days net. An alternative provides a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for agreeing to the longer term. That gives both sides the planning certainty you asked for, with a binding volume across the whole contract.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the binding volume and the full contract term, and it is the clearest footing for your pricing committee. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.02; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Your committee only has to approve one thing: Option A commits Hollerau to a binding annual volume over the full contract term, with the payment term set out in the offer. Everything is in one structured block, so it can go to the committee as it stands. Could you take Option A up to the people who decide? If the approval needs anything more from us, we will provide it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
